# Contributing

Thank you for your interest in this project.

## Contribution Policy

This repository is published for transparency, reproducibility, and scientific audit purposes. It is not open for external contributions.

We do not accept:

- Pull requests
- Feature requests
- Code contributions

## Reporting Issues

If you find an error in the methodology or code that affects the validity of results, please contact us directly at [info@azahardata.com](mailto:info@azahardata.com) rather than opening a GitHub issue.

## Using This Code

You are welcome to fork this repository and adapt the code for your own research under the terms of the [AGPL-3.0 license](../LICENSE). If you do so, we ask that you cite this work appropriately (see [CITATION.cff](../CITATION.cff)).

## Questions

For questions about the methodology or results, see [SUPPORT.md](SUPPORT.md).
